name: 66210 · Overland Park, KS
findings: ZIP 66210 (Overland Park) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66210 (Overland Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66210 (Overland Park) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 61 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
